nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Free Gmail account + an app password (not your normal password) works fine for IMAP. No paid tier needed.

nodes.name: Call Extraction Service
nodes.notes: This is the entire pipeline on the n8n side, on purpose. Idempotency, extraction, confidence scoring, and the auto-route/review-queue decision all live in extraction-service (see extraction-service/app.py) as tested Python -- n8n's job here is only trigger + one HTTP call. See CLAUDE.md and spec section 3 for why. URL is localhost:8000 because this project runs n8n and extraction-service both natively, not in Docker (see LOGS.md) -- if you're on the docker-compose.yml path instead, change this to http://extraction-service:8000/extract (the Docker network hostname).
